move: badge pops in from blur, logo draws, text rises, gloss sweeps, lifts, blurs out
how: A black rounded App Store badge with a drawn-line logo, two masked text lines and a floor shadow sits centred on a soft radial stage. Over the first 23% of the 3s loop the badge scales 0.5 to 1 with rotation -8 to 0 and filter blur 14px to 0 with back.out(1.8) while the shadow grows in; the three logo strokes draw with DrawSVG staggered 0.1s from 0.25s; 'Download on the' and 'App Store' rise from yPercent 120 with expo.out at 0.45 and 0.55s. At 1.0s a skewed gloss strip sweeps x 0 to 640 with power2.inOut over 0.7s. From 1.5s the badge lifts 8px with power2.out as the shadow shrinks, and returns at 2.0s. At 2.6s (87%) the badge shrinks to 0.6, rotates +6, blurs 12px and fades with power3.in so the frame empties for the loop.
adapt: Swap the logo paths, the two text lines and the black/border colours (a white variant exists); keep the badge 420x124 proportion or scale everything. Keep the back.out(1.8) entry with blur and the gloss sweep at a third of the duration.
port: mount(el, shot) builds shadow and badge (logo svg with three paths, two masked lines, shine) inside el; register DrawSVGPlugin. animate returns the timeline with entry 0 to 0.233D, draw 0.083D, text 0.15D / 0.183D, gloss 0.333D, lift 0.5D to 0.833D, exit 0.867D. The from() tweens on paths and text need immediateRender:false; scope selectors to el.
caveats: filter: blur tweened on the badge during entry and exit
